Title: Python 2.7 available for App Service on Linux

Body.Content:
Python 2.7 has been added to the public preview of Python on Azure App Service (Linux). 

With this addition, developers can enjoy the productivity benefits and scaling features of Azure App Service using Python 2.7, 3.6, or 3.7. For more details about the public preview of Python support on Azure App Service (Linux), see the blog post.
